It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

Competing for top spot are Danny Parker, head chef at Michelin starred 'House of Tides' in Newcastle, who is back to try his luck in the competition again after being knocked out in the regional heat last year following a tense tie-break. He's taking on two newcomers: Dan Fletcher, protégé of Phil Howard, and now head chef at 'Fenchurch' in the City of London, and David Coulson, who runs 'Peace and Loaf' in Newcastle, which boasts 2 AA rosettes.

After a tense starter course the chefs are all aiming for 10s with their unique fish dishes. David is celebrating a personal connection to the brief with his `My Cod I Bet Me Ma'am Has Seen Some Trotters', a tribute to his mum who has worked as a chiropodist. Dan's `For All Those Sleepless Nights' pays tribute to night shift workers from the NHS with some bold but classic flavours while Danny's `Not All Superheroes Wear Capes' aims to give a taste of luxury to the hardworking staff.

Dan pays tribute to an icon of modern nursing, Florence Nightingale, while Danny is inspired by the founder of the NHS, Aneurin Bevan. David's dish is dedicated to the air ambulance staff who saved the life of his fiancé, and he even takes a trip to meet one of them.

It's the chefs' last chance to impress and tensions are high. Dan takes a risk with an unusual combination of ewe's milk and bergamot while Danny is determined to pull out all the stops with his complex dessert `Aunty Gwen's Chocolate'. David hopes to transform a childhood comfort classic into a show stopping dessert. Dan also takes a trip to meet Dr Ben Clarke who was working in the Royal London Hospital A&E during the London Bridge terror attack.
The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

Banquet champion Selin Kiazim, a rising star of the London scene renowned for her Turkish Cypriot fusion flavours, is back hoping to join the elite group of chefs who have made it to the banquet twice. She is up against James Cochran who's worked at some of London's toughest kitchens including 2 Michelin starred 'The Ledbury' and Scott Goss from 'The Twenty Six' in Tunbridge Wells, renowned for his use of local Kent ingredients.

The chefs do battle for the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen is tense. Lobster is catch of the day for James whose dish is Caribbean-inspired. Scott is attempting to elevate a classic fish pie, dedicated to his mum who worked as a pharmacist in the NHS for 23 years. And Selin is taking a risk with a complex three-part fish dish featuring sardines, scallops and langoustines, as a nod to the purported health benefits of a Mediterranean diet.

Scott is showcasing rare-breed Tamworth pork to say thank you to the rare breed of people who work for the NHS. Selin is serving a complex duck dish using ingredients from all around the world to honour `Our Global NHS'. And James is presenting five cuts of goat cooked in five different ways, for his bold dish `Under The Knife'.

Selin puts her own unique twist on tea and toast. James creates a decadent coconut parfait accompanied by mango purée filled doughnuts for his dessert 'Tree of Life' inspired by the coconut palm tree, the NHS and both of their contributions to our health. Scott hopes his elevated gypsy tart 'Honey Bee Good' will secure him a place in the final.
The two remaining London and the south-east chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they remake their 'Feast To Say Thank You'?

Vying to be crowned champion of Scotland are three newcomers to the GBM kitchen. Lorna McNee is a former Scottish Chef of the Year and is renowned for her technical precision, gained from working at two-Michelin-starred restaurant 'Andrew Fairlie'.

It is the fish course and the chefs are all out to impress. The heat is increased as all three serve their unique takes on lobster. Ross seeks victory with his dish 'Lobster Aid'. Lorna's 'Live Well, Live Very Well' features only three elements.

pr.t: The Air War: The Escalation of Allied Bombing
pr.d: The filmmaker sheds light on the controversial bombing campaigns that were unleashed during World War II and explores whether they actually achieved their intended outcomes.
The documentary details the Bismarck's search and sinking, featuring naval historians and Angus Konstam.

In the run-up to September 1939, political and economic chaos in the aftermath of World War I allowed Hitler in Germany, Mussolini in Italy and ultranationalists in imperial Japan to seize absolute power.

Germany took just four weeks to conquer Poland, using a new form of warfare, Blitzkrieg. Six armoured tank units known as Panzer divisions, supported by the Luftwaffe, quickly broke through Polish defences.

After the retreat from Dunkirk, Churchill rallied Britain in its darkest hour. Hitler was only just across the channel, but he reckoned without our supreme strategist, the might of the navy and the manoeuvrability of the air force.

No matter when or where the conflict, truth often becomes the first casualty of war. John A Kantara looks at how war propaganda has used a variety of tools to spread particular narratives, including paintings, television, and social media.
A look at how religion has served as a reliable tool to brandish political power over thousands of years and been the catalyst for war, conflict, and persecution, from the Crusades to witch hunts.

Dan Jones visits Lancaster Castle to explore its grisly history of crime and punishment, including the infamous Lancashire Witches trials and the martyrdom of the Jesuit priest Saint Edmund Arrowsmith.
Dan Jones visits the heart of the English countryside to explore Arundel Castle and the dramatic history of the Earls of Arundel.

Alice visits Canterbury for the story of Plantagenet England. Canterbury is steeped in history and the era of the Plantagenets - the strong house that held the English throne from 1154 until 1485 - saw the most dramatic episodes in the city's story.
Alice Roberts explores the story of Stewart Britain by visiting Stirling, the home of the Scottish royals who eventually took the English throne in 1603 and created Great Britain.

Dr Roberts explores Norfolk, Orkney and Devon for ancient remains of lost civilisations. She finds early flint tools, ancient shipwrecks and evidence of early religion, including cattle skulls and goddess statues.

Eine Investorin bittet die Kalamas, ihre problematische Mietimmobilie zu retten, obwohl sie das Haus selbst noch nie gesehen haben.

Kamohai und Tristyn wollen es mit einem sanierungsbedürftigen Gebäude aus dem Jahr 1975 aufnehmen: Es gibt erhebliche Termitenschäden, Wasserschäden und strukturelle Mängel wie ein beschädigtes Dach und ein unzureichendes Fundament.

Ein Vater-Tochter-Duo, das als Feuerwehrmann und Krankenpflegerin Leben rettet, sucht in St. Augustine, Florida, nach einem Zuhause an der Küste. Sie träumen von Sonnenuntergängen am Meer und gemeinsamen Grillabenden mit der Familie.

Nachdem ein Hurrikan ihr Zuhause zerstört hat, möchte ein Paar in Hernando Beach, Florida, noch einmal neu anfangen. Die beiden hoffen auf ein ruhigeres Leben am Wasser und suchen nach einem passenden Strandhaus.

Mike und Abbi sind um die ganze Welt gereist, um einen schönen Ort zu finden, wo sie leben möchten. Auf Big Island haben sie für sich und ihre Hunde das Paradies gefunden. Sie lieben das Gemeinschaftsgefühl und das langsame Tempo der Insel.

Andy erhält eines Tages zufällig einen neuen Job auf Hawaii und sucht dort gemeinsam mit seiner Familie nach einem Haus. Das Anwesen soll modern sein und nicht zu weit von der Stadt entfernt liegen. Andy wünscht sich außerdem einen tropischen Garten.

Die Köchin Karson lebte und arbeitete mehrere Jahre auf Yachten und sparte Geld für ihr eigenes Traumhaus auf Hawaii. Auf Big Island möchte sie ihren großen Traum verwirklichen und in der Natur leben, tauchen und segeln.

Ein sportliches und naturverbundenes Ehepaar aus Virginia zieht auf die Insel Oahu. Um ihren Jobs als Fotograf und Modedesignerin nachzugehen, brauchen die beiden genügend Platz zum gemeinsamen Arbeiten in ihrem neuen Zuhause.

Jarrod und Ali haben schon immer gern auf kleinem Raum gelebt. Als Familie ist das zwar schwierig, aber nun wollen die Besitzer eines kleinen Weinguts in einem Wettstreit zwei Minihäuser erbauen, die beide ihren ganz eigenen Stil verpasst bekommen.

Künstler Kris und Stylistin Betty fühlen sich in ihrem Leben festgefahren und sehnen sich nach Spontaneität und Freiheit. Ein Minihaus erscheint ihnen ideal, um ortsunabhängiger zu werden. Kris entwirft daraufhin ihr gemeinsames Traumhaus.

Der Industriedesigner Rob baut ein 27-Quadratmeter-Haus, das mit allen möglichen Spielereien und ökologischen Merkmalen ausgestattet ist. Dazu gehören ein Dach, das Regenwasser auffängt, Solarpaneele zum Heizen und sogar eine Kletterwand.

Charles und Dakota haben einen alten Bus gekauft, den sie in ein einzigartiges Minihaus verwandeln wollen. Die beiden haben viel Arbeit vor sich, denn ihr Plan sieht unter anderem eine Kombination aus Bett, Schreibtisch und Yogastudio vor.

Softwareingenieur Tertius wurde von Johannesburg nach Sydney versetzt und sucht nun mit seiner Familie ein neues Zuhause. Seine Frau Melissa ist nicht ganz glücklich mit dem Umzug, hofft jetzt aber auf ein Haus am Strand.

Die Sendung gibt Einblicke in die besondere Wohnungssuche zwischen Grachten. In ein fremdes Land zu ziehen und sich dort ein neues Leben aufzubauen, ist gar nicht so einfach. Hintergründe über Baustile, Bürokratie und beliebte Orte werden erläutert.

Nach Jahren harter Arbeit in einer Anwaltskanzlei in den USA nimmt Chris eine Auszeit und reist nach Asien. Als er Singapur besucht, stellt er fest, dass er dort leben möchte. Doch zuerst braucht er eine Wohnung auf dem teuersten Pflaster der Welt.

A two-bedroom detached house in Basford in Nottingham, a top-floor flat in Portsmouth and a large Edwardian terrace in Crewe are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear about their plans.

A multimillion-pound development in Farningham in Kent, an ambitious, total renovation project in Aspatria in Cumbria and a very small studio flat in Wallington in Surrey are all sold under the hammer. Martin and Lucy meet the new owners to discuss their plans.
A semi in Sutton Coldfield near Birmingham, a derelict house in a rural village near Dover in Kent and a basement without planning permission in Ipswich in Suffolk are all sold under the hammer.

A 20-year-old first-time developer, a banker turned developer and a builder who wants to create a new home for his soon-to-be-wife all buy properties at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion are in Chesterton, Hornchurch and Sudbrook to hear their plans.

A run-down listed village house in Farningham in Kent is given the wow factor while houses in Great Barr in Birmingham and Crewe in Cheshire are also given great makeovers. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and catch up on their progress after the transformations.

Lucy talks to a pastor and his wife who plan to build their dream eco house in Brompton in Kent. Meanwhile, Martin meets a first-time developer in Wolverhampton, and Dion looks at a huge building which already comes with a tenanted flat and a hair salon in Newcastle-under-Lyme.

pr.d: Every inexplicable flash or strange aircraft makes us believe we've spotted extraterrestrials, but what if they've been watching us all along?
California is home to numerous sightings of unidentified flying objects. The size of the state is a recipe for explained and unexplained sightings.
The Fermi Paradox highlights the high likelihood of advanced life in the universe.
Witnesses, abductions and mass sightings have not been considered credible enough. Finding physical evidence will be a very big step toward full disclosure.

Experts discuss the possibility of advanced alien technology that could allow UFOs to fly at blinding speed or hover effortlessly a few feet above the ground.
Some scientists believe that to find alien life we need look no further than our own backyard.

Als der Captain des Air France Flugs 447 seine beiden Co-Piloten im Cockpit allein lässt, war alles in bester Ordnung. Wenig später sorgte ein kleiner technischer Fehler dafür, dass die Männer in Panik gerieten. Sie flogen die Maschine in eine unwiderrufliche Position, die alle Insassen das Leben kosten sollte. Als der Pilot zurückkehrte, sank das Flugzeug bereits Richtung Atlantik. Die Gelegenheit, einen Notruf abzusetzen, gab es nicht mehr.

pr.d: Im Norden trainieren Crews für den Ernstfall: Vom Tiefflug bis zum Überleben auf See verlangt der Einsatz im Tornado höchste Konzentration. Wir begleiten Piloten und Offiziere im Alltag und blicken in die Zukunft der Luftwaffe.

Beim Luftmanöver Air Defender 23 trainierten Streitkräfte aus 25 Nationen ihre Reaktionsfähigkeit. Mit diesem bisher größten Luftmanöver, in dem die Handlungsfähigkeit der Luftwaffen getestet wird, senden die Staaten ein deutliches Signal.

Die Geburtsstunde des modernen Panzers ist zur Zeit des Ersten Weltkriegs. Die Briten setzen die rollenden Kampffahrzeuge aus Stahl erstmals gegen deutsche Truppen ein. Daraufhin entwickeln die Deutschen den A7V - und im Zweiten Weltkrieg Panther und Tiger. Auch Ferdinand Porsche ist mit der Maus am Bau von Panzern während des Nationalsozialismus beteiligt. Die Dokumentation gibt einen chronologischen Einblick in die Fertigung und Technik, bis zu den neuesten Modellen der Bundeswehr.

Sie sind die fliegende Kavallerie moderner Streitkräfte: Kampfhubschrauber wie der europäische Tiger. Seine Hauptaufgabe bei der Bundeswehr ist der Schutz der eigenen Soldaten im Krisen- und Kriegseinsatz sowie die Bekämpfung gegnerischer Panzer aus der Luft. Die Dokumentation stellt die ausgefeilte Technik des Tigers dar, zeigt ihn beim Einsatz in Afghanistan und begleitet die Ausbildung angehender Tiger-Piloten in Südfrankreich.

Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?

It's Christmas at Peppa's house, and everyone is opening their presents. Peppa is so happy that she falls and hurts herself, and the whole family must go to the hospital.
At Peppa's playgroup, Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
Oh dear, Miss Rabbit's train has broken down and all her passengers need to get to work. So Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train, Gertrude.
pr.sub: Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue

pr.d: Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.

Everyone is down at the lake as it's a perfect day to go boating. Miss Rabbit has all sorts of boats for hire and Daddy Pig picks one with pedals, but when all the families have a race, he soon wishes he had picked something easier to sail.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.

It's a beautiful day but Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching the motor racing on the television. Granny Pig shoos them all outside to enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.

Patrick presents a show about food after missing out on a hearty breakfast; Patrick and SpongeBob experience the wonders of the workforce.

Die Bewohner von Bikini Bottom starten ein großes Schlittenrennen zum Süd-Pol, und wer gewinnt, wird mit einer Million Dollar belohnt. Natürlich wollen alle gewinnen und reich werden, allerdings ist keinem bewusst, dass Plankton dahintersteckt.
Patrick and Grandpa try to pass each other on the stairs, leading to a ludicrous conflict. Members of the Star family confront their absurd rivalries.
pr.sub: Stair Wars; Enemies a la Mode

Drei Kindheitsfreundinnen in ihren Vierzigern fahren zur Côte d'Azur im Süden Frankreichs, um eine Ferienwohnung aufzuräumen. Dort wird Cécile, Sonia und Elise schnell bewusst, dass sie immer noch eine sehr attraktive Ausstrahlungskraft auf das andere Geschlecht haben. pr.d: Pauline freundet sich mit Leonards Kumpel Daniel an und bemerkt, dass er mehr ist als nur ein oberflächlicher Gigolo. Währenddessen bereitet sich Leonard darauf vor, den `Fürstenhof' endgültig zu verlassen. Doch er bekommt mit, dass er in seinem neuen Job ein Zweigwerk im Ausland aufbauen müsste und somit keine Möglichkeit hätte, sich um Patrizia und die Kinder zu kümmern. Schweren Herzens entscheidet er sich gegen seinen Traumjob und beschließt, am `Fürstenhof' zu bleiben.

Pauline ist es peinlich, dass sie dachte, Leonard würde ihretwegen im "Fürstenhof" bleiben. Sie vertraut sich Daniel an und erzählt ihm auch zu dessen Erstaunen, dass Leonard Vater wird. Es kommt zu einem kleinen Streit zwischen den beiden Freunden, bei dem Leonard Daniel vorwirft, Pauline anzubaggern. Daniel hält dagegen, dass Leonard Pauline immer noch liebt, aber zu feige ist, zu seinen Gefühlen zu stehen.

pr.t: Aileen: Life and Death of a Serial Killer
pr.d: This feature-length film examines Aileen's harrowing life, tracing her story from the freezing woods of Michigan to the steamy swamps of Florida, and features her closest friends, her lawyers and even her estranged birth mother. At the heart of the film are the astonishing, unique, troubled interviews Broomfield filmed with Wuornos in prison, including her last, defiant words before execution.
Harold Shipman was a respected doctor, but he was killing his older patients. His murder spree has claimed at least 215 lives and the families of the dead wanted him to pay in court.
A young man meets a mystery woman, then vanishes; and a teenage girl disappears walking home from school. Luckily a psychic saw everything.
A New Jersey woman is beaten to death with a hammer and, in Louisiana, a frenzied struggle leaves a young mother dead and her son beaten.
In Illinois, a teenage boy goes to a job interview and vanishes. In New Jersey, two women are abducted and brutally murdered.
When a single mother goes missing in California and a New Jersey woman's ex-husband kidnaps her kids, psychics help each family search for justice.

Following a team of experts as they investigate whether evidence exists that could challenge the conviction of a man in prison for a murder he denies. Every year, over 500 people in the UK are convicted of murder. A guilty verdict can only be challenged if new evidence comes to light. Inside Justice is a specialist charity led by Louise Shorter, supported by a panel of criminal lawyers, ex-police officers and forensics experts who offer assistance to prisoners who are protesting their innocence.

Louise investigates a case, looking for evidence that could present grounds to bring an appeal, and ultimately overturn the conviction of a Southampton man in prison for the murder of his secret lover.
The Tasmanian tiger was once thought to be long extinct, but recent evidence invokes a special team to track it down. A large den and footprints generate excitement.

Go on an expedition beyond the bars of 12 of Western Germany's most popular zoos, get up close to some of the most intriguing animals on the planet, and witness their undisturbed behaviours and fascinating social interactions.
Many exotic animals that are threatened in the distant wilderness find a refuge in zoos in Europe.

In this first part we look at the state of nature in Central Europe. From the peaks of the Alps to the marshes, from the farmlands to the coasts. Unique images provide insight into this familiar, yet often still unknown habitat.

We see meadows, moors and coasts from their most beautiful side and get to know the animals that live there. But we are also confronted with the problems that exist and the state of our environment. Nitrogen is an ever-increasing danger.

The Alblasserwaard is the habitat of black-tailed godwits, purple herons, hares, barnacle geese, roe deer, moor frogs, marsh harriers and argus butterflies. The animals are followed at defining moments in their lives.
A look at how nature took over one of Europe's largest abandoned industrial zones in Germany's Ruhr area after 150 years.
A brutal double murder, spiritually charged ley lines, and an ancient Druid ritual site spell disaster at a notoriously haunted home in County Donegal, Ireland.

Best friends Griff and Doug head to the jungles of the Amazon to film a reboot of their all-time favourite movie "Anaconda." However, life soon imitates art when a gigantic anaconda with a thirst for blood starts hunting them down.
The tragic story of 72-year-old Jane Hings, whose carers discovered her murdered in her bungalow home in Fleckney, Leicestershire, after 25-year-old Craig Keogh raped and killed her.
Mark Sievers refused to cooperate with the investigation into the brutal murder of wife Teresa, fuelling the suspicions police already had about him, but an unexpected hint helped solve the case.
Known as the 'Acid Bath Murderer', John George Haigh preyed on 1940s London with gruesome killings that saw him dissolve the bodies of his victims in acid before he poured the sludge down the drain.
From the pursuit of a drink driver to an escalating domestic dispute, police officers responding to incidents in West Wales have their work cut out for them.

A driver on the run from police crashes into a stop sign and risks a head-on collision with a bus, and the question remains whether he will escape both the police and a serious smash.
Officers Damien O'Brien and Steve Mottram stop a woman who likes to let her dog ride shotgun even when her boyfriend is in the car.

Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison, she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.

pr.t: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
pr.d: When his father's job results in a family move to the countryside, young German boy Bruno misses his old friends. Roaming the grounds of the large country house he now calls home, he discovers the huge fenced facility that his dad Ralf, a Nazi officer, now administers. Approaching it, Bruno meets Shmuel, a Jewish boy on the other side of the barbed wire, wearing what appears to be a pair of pyjamas.
When her father is murdered, 14-year-old girl Mattie Ross hires grizzled US Marshal Rooster Cogburn to track down the killer into hostile Indian territory. Based on Charles Portis' novel.
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

Frederick Manion, an army lieutenant, is arrested for the murder of bartender Barney Quill. In defence, he claims that the victim had beaten and raped his wife. With such evidence somewhat lacking, Manion's lawyer, Paul Biegler attempts to save his defendant from prosecution, setting his assistants in search of witnesses.
Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

pr.t: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
pr.d: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

June is a wildly imaginative girl who finds herself in Wonderland -- an amusement park she created in her mind. With the park falling into disarray, she soon teams up with a group of lovable animals to try and save Wonderland before its lost forever.
A ragtag band of humans bands together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea.
Fang-in-cheek tale about a single-parent family who move to the coastal town of Santa Clara where the local juvenile delinquents are actually a pack of vampires.

Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.

Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private are recruited by a secret organisation to help bring down an evil supervillain, Doctor Octavius Brine. He holds a grudge against the animals that stole the limelight from him.

A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

pr.t: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
pr.d: Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.

Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?
Framed for the murder of his billionaire boss, a vengeful man uncovers an international conspiracy as he battles a gang of thugs aboard a cargo ship.

A few weeks into their van life adventure, a young couple witnesses an accident that leaves the driver dead. Soon, they're being pursued by a demonic stalker who's impossible to outrun and follows them wherever they go.

Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of a mall store after hours. When a new hire challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.
Identical twins Abigail and Charlie travel to Wales to manage a bookshop for Christmas. Romance and mistaken identity follow as two local men woo the sisters, unaware they are twins.
After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas-themed bar, she must square off against a neighbouring competitor to save it from its drowning debt.

It's been 40 years since Laurie Strode survived a vicious attack from crazed killer Michael Myers on Halloween night. She now faces a terrifying showdown when the masked madman returns to Haddonfield, Illinois, but this time, Laurie's ready for him.

After the loss of her husband, a grieving woman seeks solace with her in-laws at their secluded family home. However, it soon becomes a reunion from hell as the Book of the Dead unleashes demonic forces that transform them into Deadites one by one.

Cal Lynch travels back in time to 15th-century Spain through a revolutionary technology that unlocks the genetic memories contained in his DNA. There, he lives out the experiences of Aguilar de Nerha, a distant relative who's also a member of the Assassins, a secret society that fights to protect free will from the power-hungry Templar Order. Transformed by the past, Cal begins to gain the knowledge and physical skills necessary to battle the oppressive organisation in the present.

Dr Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. When tragedy strikes, Louis turns to his neighbour Jud Crandall, setting off a perilous chain reaction that unleashes an unspeakable evil with horrific consequences.

Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.

An amnesiac schoolteacher discovers she was formerly a government assassin when she hires a low-rent private eye to help fill the gaps in her memory. Together, they go on the run in a race against the clock to stop her former taskmasters from putting a heinous plan into action, before they can silence her for good.

Luther Krank, fed up with the commercialism of Christmas, decides to skip the holiday and go on holiday with his wife, an easy decision to make with their daughter away anyway, but when she suddenly decides to come home, uproar ensues in the rush to celebrate Christmas at the last minute.
When four generations of the Cooper clan come together for their annual Christmas Eve celebration, a series of unexpected visitors and unlikely events turn the night upside down.

A family gathers on Christmas Eve for what could be the last holiday in their ancestral home. As the night wears on and tensions arise, one of the teenagers sneaks out with her friends to claim the wintry suburb for her own.
It's the most wonderful time of the year! From the Grinch's Christmas mischief to the romance of 'Last Christmas', celebrate the season with our festive Cinema List.

pr.d: The murder of Austria's crown prince leads Holmes, Watson and a Gypsy to a showdown with an evil genius named Moriarty.

Henry Hill knows only too well that he must put the Mob's interests before everything, even his family, but when the good times turn sour, his loyalties dissolve in the face of greater rewards. Faced with a terrible retribution, Hill can see only one way to get out alive.

A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

pr.d: Fire Chief Franklin rescues Fisherman Charlie and the kids honour him with a medal of bravery. But who will rescue the medal when it disappears?
Fisherman Charlie's new puppy Hudson does not share, so Clifford, Bailey and Tucker start puppy school to teach him to be mindful of others.
Pablo's butterfly hatches, and he is so excited to play with her! But butterflies aren't happy in jars and Pablo learns to empathise with his new friend.
Emily Elizabeth and Clifford get up extra early to go berry picking, but they get carried away and don't leave any berries for the rest of Birdwell Island!
Emily Elizabeth and friends start their own farm. With the help of Farmer Jones and Emily Elizabeth's Dad, the kids learn what is required to make a garden grow.

The twins decide that everyone must get active and turn Tickety Town into a boot camp. With Tommy banging his drum and Tallulah blowing on her trumpet, soon everyone is lifting, running, puffing, and panting. They are all so exhausted that they fall fast asleep, but with Chime Time imminent, they must find a way to wake up Pufferty's wheels.

When Hopparoo bursts all their bubbles with his sharp ears, the twins use McCoggins' extra-strong bubble mixture instead and blow a bubble so huge that it engulfs Battersby, Madame Au Lait, McCoggins, Lopsiloo, Chikidee, and finally Tommy and Tallulah themselves. The twins will need to find Hopparoo, as only his sharp ears can free them for Chime Time.

Tommy and Tallulah love dressing up and surprising each other with their crazy costumes, but Hopparoo is not impressed when they decide to surprise everybody else in town, too. In their efforts to surprise the bunny, they give the Spring Chicks such a fright that they barricade themselves in front of the clock house, blocking the way to Chime Time.

Madame Au Lait is teaching the twins pottery and shows them a magnificent cow pot that she made on her wheel to inspire them, but they accidentally smash it when she leaves them to their enthusiastic pot-making. The twins only make things worse when they try to repair it, as huge quantities of clay fly from their wheel into the town, blocking Pufferty's tracks.

Hopparoo finds himself disappointed during Measuring Time, leaving Tommy and Tallulah to offer up ideas about how to add inches, but a super-tall rabbit rampaging through town on stilts can only cause chaos.

Tommy and Tallulah are playing pirates as they hunt for Madame Au Lait's treasure, but rival pirate Hopparoo keeps trying to commandeer their cardboard boat by telling them it is Chime Time, causing them twice to abandon ship and run. So they do not believe him when Chime Time really comes around.

The twins are under strict instructions to keep clean for Madame Au Lait's town photograph, but this proves difficult when the rest of the town needs their help with some messy jobs. So when it is time for their picture, Tommy and Tallulah find themselves covered in mud, compost, and feathers.

When Tommy and Tallulah want to throw a magnificent party to celebrate McCoggins' birthday, the twins organise the decorations, music, and food, but Chikidee causes chaos after he gets stuck in a giant cake.

Armed with his trusty Appleton's Guide, Michael Portillo reaches San Francisco, where he boards one of the city's iconic cable cars. Behind the scenes in the engineering powerhouse, he uncovers the street cars' secret to scaling the city's famously steep hills. In the Presidio neighbourhood, a leading publisher introduces Michael to San Francisco's long tradition of fine printing and book-making. Michael takes the opportunity to have his own treasured book appraised.

Following his Appleton's guide, Michael Portillo makes a trip to the jewel in the crown of America's National Parks, Yosemite, to behold its towering granite cliffs, its giant sequoia trees and cascading waterfalls. He discovers how early conservationists fought to protect it in law and encounters a 'buffalo soldier' in the heart of the forest. In Berkeley, Michael uncovers a catastrophic event, which hit the city of San Francisco hard in 1906.

Steered by his late 19th-century Appleton's guidebook, Michael Portillo continues through southern California aboard the Coast Starlight rail service. In the historic port of Monterey, Michael raises the Bear Flag of the one-time Republic of California and above it, the Stars and Stripes. He discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage and traces how the former fishing port described as 'stinking and decrepit' in John Steinbeck's novel, 'Cannery Row', has become a beacon for tourists.

Michael Portillo strikes oil in the suburbs of Los Angeles, contemplates his navel in the orange groves of Riverside, makes a California roll and paints a pretty picture in Laguna Beach. It is Mexican Independence Day and the locals are celebrating the country's hard-won independence from Spain in the early 19th century.

Michael Portillo's nineteenth-century Appleton's guidebook leads him to the Parker House Hotel, where in his best pinny, he whisks up a Boston cream pie. In the fine dome atop Massachusetts General Hospital, where no-one could hear the screaming, Michael discovers the scene of grisly surgery, first made bearable, in 1846, by a miraculous new substance. North of Boston, in Salem, Michael is caught up in a witch hunt.

Guided by his Appleton's and tracing the footsteps of the Pilgrim Fathers, Michael Portillo heads for Plymouth, the 'home town' of America. He learns how indigenous tribes of Wampanoag people taught newly arrived settlers to live off the land, inspiring one of the biggest holidays in today's American calendar.
Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on nature's most amazing animals, including a look at how the emperor penguin breeds and the wood frog, which freezes solid.

Beginning in the Silver State of Nevada, Michael takes to the skies over the dramatic Sierra Nevada mountain range. At Lake Tahoe, he hears of the first European explorer, known as 'The Pathfinder', whose discovery opened up the west for settlement. Travelling on the historic Virginia and Truckee heritage line, Michael investigates the vast deposits of silver and gold ore on which Virginia City was built.

Armed with his trusty Appleton's Guide, Michael Portillo reaches San Francisco, where he boards one of the city's iconic cable cars. Behind the scenes in the engineering powerhouse, he uncovers the street cars' secret to scaling the city's famously steep hills. In the Presidio neighbourhood, a leading publisher introduces Michael to San Francisco's long tradition of fine printing and book-making. Michael takes the opportunity to have his own treasured book appraised.

Following his Appleton's guide, Michael Portillo makes a trip to the jewel in the crown of America's National Parks, Yosemite, to behold its towering granite cliffs, its giant sequoia trees and cascading waterfalls. He discovers how early conservationists fought to protect it in law and encounters a 'buffalo soldier' in the heart of the forest. In Berkeley, Michael uncovers a catastrophic event, which hit the city of San Francisco hard in 1906.

Steered by his late 19th-century Appleton's guidebook, Michael Portillo continues through southern California aboard the Coast Starlight rail service. In the historic port of Monterey, Michael raises the Bear Flag of the one-time Republic of California and above it, the Stars and Stripes. He discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage and traces how the former fishing port described as 'stinking and decrepit' in John Steinbeck's novel, 'Cannery Row', has become a beacon for tourists.

Rehab centres are treating some of their youngest-ever and most physically damaged addicts, and ketamine has been their drug of choice. Stacey Dooley gains rare access to a rehab in Stockport and gets to know former users. Many are in chronic pain, and one young man needs bladder reconstruction surgery. Over four months, she follows them through recovery, relationships, setbacks and celebrations.

A not-so-clever plan to earn some extra cash backfires, bringing the lads head-to-head with Sergeant Healy, who has been hot on their heels for some time and is determined to catch them up to no good. They also may have been caught in the act by Principal Walsh's two daughters, Siobhán and Linda, so the lads need to turn on the charm to persuade the girls not to spill the beans, which only serves to further irritate Principal Walsh.

Conor and Jock's friendships with principal Walsh's daughters Linda and Siobhan intensify, causing awkward tension between the lads, the principal, and the girls themselves. Conor and Jock crash a Walsh family barbecue, and principal Walsh's wife Orla is intent on her husband giving the lads a chance: they can't be all that bad, can they?

There's only one thing left for Conor and Jock to do to get Linda and Siobhan to really fall for them: spend a whole day together on a beautiful adventure. A sick day from school is the only way they can do this, leading to various difficulties.

Die Jungs müssen ihre WG absichern, als sie planen, zum ersten Mal zusammen LSD zu nehmen. Leider muss Anders zu einem spontanen Arbeitsausflug in ein zwielichtiges Hotel, in dem er einen Kunden namens "Barracuda" treffen soll.

In dieser neuen Folge lernt ein Außerirdischer in einem Sketch etwas über die weibliche Anatomie. Außerdem übertreffen sich die Jungs gegenseitig mit ihren neuen Hüten und treffen die letzten beiden Männer auf dem Planeten.

Timmys Lehrer diagnostizieren bei ihm das Aufmerksamkeitsdefizit-Syndrom. Prompt bekommt er von einem Arzt Ritalin verschrieben. Auch von den Hausaufgaben wird er befreit, was bei den anderen Schülern für Neid sorgt.

Kenny will mit allen Mitteln verhindern, dass seine Eltern noch ein Kind zeugen. Cartman hat unterdessen andere Probleme: Er möchte sich reifere, ältere Freunde suchen. Er nutzt dafür das Internet - und ist erfolgreich. Zumindest fast.

Beavis und Butt-Head versuchen, einen Escape-Room zu lösen, landen jedoch unbeabsichtigt im Badezimmer, wo ihre schrulligen Versuche, sich zu befreien, zu komischen Missgeschicken führen. Beavis trifft auf seinen größten Helden, Fire.
Beavis und Butt-Head bleiben auf dem Dach von Tom Andersons Haus stecken. Beavis und Butt-Head unternehmen eine Schlauchbootfahrt auf einem Fluss, verirren sich aber im Meer.

Das gibt es nur im Big Apple und in dieser Animationsserie: Ein Zombie, ein Fantasy-Freak und ein ganz normaler Sozialarbeiter treffen in New York zusammen. Mark Lilly hat es nicht leicht. Sein Mitbewohner ist ein Untoter und die Chefin ein Dämon.

Die Mitbewohner treffen sich zum ersten Mal. Foxxy fühlt sich rassistisch beleidigt, als Clara sie für eine Hausangestellte hält. Toot erkennt, dass sie kein Sexsymbol mehr ist. Foxxy und Clara vertragen sich im Whirlpool mit einem Kuss.

Viele Menschen sehnen sich danach, sich immer weiter selbst zu optimieren, doch das führt nicht immer zu Glück und Zufriedenheit. Der Moderator will in dieser Episode wissen, warum viele so viel Geld für einen Motivationscoach ausgeben.

Cleveland Jr. hat sich verliebt. Seine Angebetete ist die gläubige Vanessa, für die er an einem Kirchenausflug teilnimmt. Währenddessen erwartet Donnas Exfreund eine Überraschung, als er feststellt, dass sie verheiratet ist.

Cleveland plant eine Überraschung für Donna am Muttertag, doch nicht alles läuft nach Plan. Er heuert eine Schauspielerin an, die Donnas Mutter spielen soll. Doch plötzlich steht ihre richtige Mutter vor der Tür.
